description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class for services within the Eclipse Hono project. It provides lifecycle management (start/stop), health check registration, port configuration, TLS setup, and tracing integration for services that bind to secure and/or insecure ports.

classes.name: AbstractServiceBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing foundational functionality for Eclipse Hono services, including lifecycle management, port configuration, TLS setup, health checks, and tracing support.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the service, registers health check resources, and invokes subclass-specific startup logic via startInternal.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the service by invoking stopInternal and completing the stop future.

methods.name: registerReadinessChecks
methods.description: Allows subclasses to register readiness health checks.

methods.name: registerLivenessChecks
methods.description: Allows subclasses to register liveness health checks.

methods.name: getPortDefaultValue
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to return default secure port.

methods.name: getInsecurePortDefaultValue
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to return default insecure port.

methods.name: getActualPort
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the port the secure server is listening on, if any.

methods.name: getActualInsecurePort
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the port the insecure server is listening on, if any.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Determines the port number for secure communication, based on current binding or configuration.

methods.name: getInsecurePort
methods.description: Determines the port number for insecure communication, based on current binding or configuration.

methods.name: checkPortConfiguration
methods.description: Validates that port configurations are correct and do not conflict.

methods.name: determineSecurePort
methods.description: Determines which secure port the service should bind to, including default and configured values.

methods.name: determineInsecurePort
methods.description: Determines which insecure port the service should bind to, including default and configured values.

methods.name: isSecurePortEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the secure port is enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: isInsecurePortEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the insecure port is enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: getBindAddress
methods.description: Returns the hostname or IP the secure server binds to.

methods.name: getInsecurePortBindAddress
methods.description: Returns the hostname or IP the insecure server binds to.

methods.name: addTlsTrustOptions
methods.description: Configures trust options for TLS if SSL is enabled and trust options are not set.

methods.name: getServerTrustOptions
methods.description: Provides the trust options for TLS; default is from configuration.

methods.name: addTlsKeyCertOptions
methods.description: Configures key and certificate options for TLS, enabling SSL and OpenSSL if available.

methods.name: getTracer
methods.description: Returns the current OpenTracing tracer instance.

methods.name: setTracer
methods.description: Sets the OpenTracing tracer instance; defaults to a no-op tracer.

methods.name: getHealthCheckServer
methods.description: Retrieves the current health check server.

methods.name: setHealthCheckServer
methods.description: Sets the health check server.
